description:
Draw a single continuous line to connect numbers and completely fill the grid!
Unleash your logic with One Line, the ultimate daily brain-training puzzle game! 🧠

Looking for a satisfying mental workout? Inspired by classic path-finding mechanics, One Line challenges you to solve intricate grid puzzles using just a single, continuous stroke. It is the perfect game to sharpen your mind during your morning commute, lunch break, or evening wind-down.

How to Play:
1. Start at the number one.
2. Draw a continuous line connecting the sequential numbers in order.
3. The Ultimate Challenge: You must fill every single square on the grid without crossing your own path!
